kswe01.title: Aries Woke Up Patient
kswe01.caption:
Aries woke up as a Taurus and did the unthinkable: put the phone face down and made soup.
Two hours, zero follow-up texts. Who in your life needs this swap?

kswe02.title: Taurus Woke Up Spontaneous
kswe02.caption:
A text at 10:47 PM: wanna go out right now? Taurus, in a Sagittarius body, was already out the door in slippers.
What time is too late for a yes?

kswe03.title: Gemini Woke Up With a Plan
kswe03.caption:
One hour of where are we eating. Then Gemini woke up a Capricorn and booked the noodle place in one message.
Tag the friend who finally decides.

kswe04.title: Cancer Woke Up Chill
kswe04.caption:
The ex texted hey stranger and Cancer, briefly an Aquarius, replied kindly and archived it in one breath. Then the swap wore off.
Feelings: fully back, and honestly welcome.

kswe05.title: Leo Woke Up Listening
kswe05.caption:
Leo woke up a Virgo and spent a whole first date asking questions. Remembered the cat's name and everything.
Inner Leo is still screaming about the hair.

kswe06.title: Virgo Woke Up Feeling Everything
kswe06.caption:
Virgo woke up a Pisces and cried at a dog, a sunset and one text that said you look nice.
The fix was labelled jars. The jars did not help.
